lee (DevEx): Noticed onboarding go-sample (realtime-chat) had message duplication when a 429 hits during refresh + retry. Slightly different pattern from uploads.

oliver (SDK-Go): paste logs?

lee (DevEx):
```
[2026-04-05T16:00:00Z] POST /v1/messages -> 200 msg=1
[2026-04-05T16:00:00Z] auth refresh start
[2026-04-05T16:00:00Z] POST /v1/messages -> 429 retrying
[2026-04-05T16:00:01Z] POST /v1/messages -> 200 msg=2
```

riley (Platform): commit endpoints aside, chat should dedupe on client_message_id if provided. Does go-sample omit that?

lee (DevEx): sample uses simple sendMessage(text) which calls SDK.Send(text) with no client_message_id.

oliver (SDK-Go): plan: add `ClientMessageID` auto-generation for chat sends when `auto_idempotency` enabled. For Go, use a stable monotonic per-client counter + node-id to keep it readable for users and deterministic across retries. Also ensure header `X-Client-Message-Id`.

sam (QA): tests to validate ordering and dedupe when refresh happens mid-send. Also test when users intentionally call Send twice (should be two messages).

riley (Platform): server role: honor `X-Client-Message-Id` and if duplicate, return 200 with `X-Idempotency-Status: replayed` and same message id. We'll add a per-channel TTL of 120s by default.

oliver (SDK-Go): backoff: switch to full jitter expo with base=50ms cap=5s attempts=4 for chat to retain snappy UX.

lee (DevEx): docs: call out difference between `auto_idempotency` (sdk-level) and explicit client_message_id (app-level). Provide sample snippet in Go and JS.

oliver (SDK-Go): will open PR and enable in go-sample. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/128

bot-deploy: staging deploy started for branch go/idempotency-msgid at 2026-04-05T16:15:00Z

lee (DevEx): thanks all, let's track cross-SDK parity so we ship similar defaults across languages.
